articles.title: Common medications may secretly rewire your gut, with effects lasting for years
articles.summary: Medications taken years or even long ago may leave lasting changes in your gut microbiome, according to a study of more than 2,500 people. Surprisingly, some anxiety medications had effects comparable to broad-spectrum antibiotics.
